description: Source code for the SM351LT sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, trigger handling, and data fetching.

methods.name: sm351lt_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets trigger for proximity sensor events, configuring GPIO interrupt and callback.

methods.name: sm351lt_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO interrupt callback that signals semaphore or submits work based on trigger configuration.

methods.name: sm351lt_thread_cb
methods.description: Invokes the user-defined handler when a trigger event occurs.

methods.name: sm351lt_thread
methods.description: Thread function that waits on semaphore and calls trigger handler.

methods.name: sm351lt_work_cb
methods.description: Work handler that calls the trigger callback.

methods.name: sm351lt_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data, specifically proximity status.

methods.name: sm351lt_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the latest sensor data for a specified channel.

methods.name: sm351lt_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attribute, such as trigger type.

methods.name: sm351lt_attr_get
methods.description: Gets sensor attribute, such as trigger type.

methods.name: sm351lt_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, configures GPIO and trigger mechanisms.
